visualCharacteristics: Single collapsed item directly under a video, bold label with chevron, bottom border only, no box
contentPattern: One row per item. Column 1: item label (e.g. 'Transcript'). Column 2: transcript paragraphs.
usage: Collapsible transcript placed directly after an embed-video block.
reuseGuidance: Use for video transcripts or similar single expandable text panels. For FAQ-style boxed accordions use the standard accordion.
